data.desc: Electra is building allied refining capacity for North America's critical minerals supply chain, serving lithium-ion battery and defense applications. The Company is currently constructing a North American cobalt sulfate refinery, the first step in a phased midstream strategy to establish allied battery materials refining capacity and reduce reliance on concentrated foreign supply chains. Building on that platform, Electra is progressing a proposed 20,000-tonne-per-year nickel refinery in North America and advancing battery recycling to recover nickel, cobalt, lithium and other critical materials from black mass. Electra also holds a significant land package in Idaho's Cobalt Belt, including its Iron Creek cobalt-copper project.
